notes.title: Run an online store together with a Bunny!
notes.content:
A new game from the maker of <Gaokao.Love.100Days>, <Our End of the World> and <Tiny Snow>.

Humans have started a trade war!
Monsters can only struggle to survive...
A witty and hilarious comedy.
Make the store bigger and stronger together wih a bunny!

Add it to wishlist if you would like to try out later (or buy it nowːsteamhappyː)
The English translation of this game is still WIP, we'll keep updating.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: English Version Published with 20% Off
notes.content:
[b]Long time no see :sshand:[/b]

It has been a year since we shipped the game on Steam. Today we finally published the English subtitle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30894486/c9b48228607322eb120d9616256690eef6fbdc84.jpg[/img]

It was not easy, our hard-working devs translated more than [b]138k[/b] Chinese characters into [b]70k[/b] English words. We tried our best to convert all the puzzles into the different culture. Hopefully players from all over the world could enjoy the game.

If you got any issue or cannot solve the puzzle during the game, feel free to leave a message here or post your issue in 'Discussions' board. For now there is only Chinese game guide. Anyone providing game guide is more than welcome.

To run the game in English, you should wait after the update finished, right click the game and select 'English' in the Property/Language Tab. 1st run might be slow, please wait several seconds.

For known issues, please check this post:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/703700/discussions/0/1743352529765547495/

Concat us by info@nvlsoft.com 

BTW, the additinal novels have not been translated yet, we're working on it. This is extra content and won't affect the game experiences.
Enjoy the game and sales!
